title: A build-and-upload CI workflow runs on every merge to the main branch and records the uploaded version id
description: A CI workflow named `build-and-upload` (or the project's chosen equivalent) triggers on `push` to the main branch (and on any linear-history proxy the project uses). It checks the tree out, installs dependencies at the pinned versions, runs the project's build step, then invokes the Deploy Adapter's `uploadVersion` verb naming the operator-chosen preview alias string. On success it writes the uploaded version id, the version-id URL, and the preview alias URL to the CI run's job summary and to a structured output the promote workflow reads. The workflow authenticates to the vendor through named CI secrets (a vendor API token and a vendor account id); the token is scoped to the Worker's account and never appears in any log line.
rationale: The build-and-upload workflow is the mechanism half of REQ-003: every merge produces an uploaded, addressable version, without touching production. Making the version id and URLs discoverable in the CI run output is what makes the promote step's `newest-of-main` default computable and what makes the change reviewable at the preview URL by anyone with the CI run link.
